serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
I-I need to call someone for help!
You: Shanice! {f_botName} is gone! I have no idea where she is!
Shanice: W-What?! W-Wait a minute, you just woke me up!
You: My bot is gone!
Shanice: A-Alright, give me a minute. I will help you look for her, but I need to put some clothes on first…
Who else can I ask for help?
Obviously I can’t call the police.
Shanice will probably contact Priestbot, so the only person left is Big Daddy.
Damn! Why isn’t he answering?!
I should go to his place, maybe he’s asleep or something!
